purpose: Dose-response ceiling test: does restoring more high-fidelity history causally improve closed-loop success for the frozen policy on memory-intensive dev templates?

template_selection_rule.include: max_steps >= 24, OR (max_steps >= 18 AND (multi-item management OR cross-app content transcription OR stateful traversal {BrowserMaze, FilesMoveFile}))
template_selection_rule.note: applied to the 60 dev templates before any ceiling episode was run; dev-60 templates have never been executed by this project

arm_note: recent_B8 is the deterministic feasible ceiling: nine 2560-token images approach the 32k context; per-decision restored counts and prompt tokens are recorded

endpoints.primary: official_terminal_success paired at template level (mean over 3 instances)

decision_rule.story_alive: recent_B8 minus summary_B0 template-level net wins >= +3, or success-rate delta bootstrap CI excluding 0
decision_rule.story_dead: recent_B8 minus summary_B0 template-level net wins <= +1
